text: The Nightbane pack (or simply the Nightbane) are a pack of worgen in Duskwood. The Nightbane consists of both former humans and cursed night elves. Their most prominent presence is in Brightwood Grove, west of Darkshire, but they are said to have come from Roland's Doom, a cave to the south. There, Jitters found a mysterious scythe jutting from the cave wall. When he pulled it free, the worgen spontaneously began to appear, and have since grown in number. Once led by Gervase, the Nightbane pack also served Alpha Prime, with Revil Kost referring to them as the Wolf Cult. After the death of Gervase at the hand of the adventurers, Marus succeeded him as the new leader of the Nightbane pack.

The Night Watch is a policing militia created to defend Darkshire from the dangers plaguing Duskwood. The most prominent dangers they face are the undead of Raven Hill Cemetery and Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, and the worgen of Brightwood Grove and Roland's Doom. The Night Watch does what it can to keep the region safe, often relying on the recruitment of citizens and passersby to aid in their defense. Individual members are referred to as Watchers, Night Watchers, or Watchmen. They have their own office in Darkshire.
Nexus Crystal was an ingredient for high level enchantments and a blacksmithing plan.

Night Reaver is a two-handed axe. Double-edged and weighted for extra damage, this axe is also afflicted with a shadow curse that may cause extra damage. It's high-end damage and proc make an excellent axe for any low level warrior.
Nightblade is a two-handed sword with a proc that does additional Shadow damage.
__NOTOC__ Night Dragon's Breath is a special consumable from the plants of Felwood.

Night Web's Hollow is a small valley and gold mine just northwest of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. Both the outdoors vale and the indoors mine are infested with spiders, which skitter among the shadows and lurk from their webbed corners. Young Forsaken usually test their mettle against the numerous spiders and sometimes venture deep into the mine to uncover its dusty secrets. Outside the mine, Young Night Web Spiders wander about. The mine itself houses many adult Night Web Spiders. In the deepest recesses of the mine, the Night Web Matriarch sits.

Night Run is located in east-central Ashenvale, east of Raynewood Retreat and northwest of Splintertree Post. It's inhabited by the Felmusk satyr. Shortly after the Sundering, Arvell and Ralaar in Pack Form attacked the Sentinels battling the satyrs, killing Aldorei, Elanu, Morina, Tyrnas and wounding Shandris. The attack marked the beginning of the War of the Satyr. It is one of the three Ashenvale satyr settlements, the other two being Satyrnaar and Xavian. Of the three, Night Run is by far the smallest, boasting only a few broken pillars and pieces of ruined architecture as shelter for the satyr who live there. Nez'raz is a goblin zeppelin master located in the zeppelin tower in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn. He gives information about Durotar.

Niby the Almighty is a warlock located in Icecrown Citadel, who is unbelievably vain. Niby refers to people as insects and expects them to bow down to him. He was also notably incompetent. He keeps an imp as his minion, named Impsy, who holds him in an extremely low opinion.

Nezzliok the Dire is a jungle troll found in Zul'Kunda in Northern Stranglethorn. Nimboya wants to find out from Nezzliok what happened to his chief's son, Yenniku, but knowing that Nezzliok would never speak freely, he tasks adventurers with bringing him his head so Nimboya can place it within a cauldron and make it talk. Nezzliok eventually reveals that Yenniku was taken by Zanzil the Outcast.

Ni Karma is a roll bonus system, that is also zero-sum (i.e., points leave the system at about the same rate they enter). "Karma" can be thought of as "favor of the loot gods", where it skews loot towards those with the most favor. You get this favor by attending raids, and lose it when winning items. Specifically the term "DKP" is avoided because karma does not really act as currency. But for those that love the idea of DKP, they can hoard points and then it DOES act as currency... but items can become quite expensive in this case.
__NOTOC__ Night Web Matriarch is a small spider dwelling deep in Night Web's Hollow, west of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. She is the smallest of the Night Web Spiders, and the hardest to get to.
__NOTOC__ Night Web Spiders are venom spiders that have overrun the gold mine at Night Web's Hollow. Executor Arren recruits newly risen Forsaken to help clear the mine.

Nexus-King Salhadaar was once the ruler of the people of K'aresh, until Dimensius ravaged the Ethereal homeworld and scattered the race across the Twisting Nether. The old ruling class of K'aresh, known as the Ethereum which he leads, is committed to defeating Dimensius and the Void by any means necessary, including transforming into void creatures themselves. It has been a thousand years since he began his crusade. Salhadaar was killed in the Netherstorm.
See Nightbane quest chain for a summary of this quest chain.
Night Watch Shortsword is a world drop. It is named after the Night Watch militia.
Nifty Stopwatch is a quest reward from This Is Going to Be Hard (3).
Night Watch Pantaloons were a quest reward from Morbent Fel (quest).
Night Watch Gauntlets were a reward from the quest Eight-Legged Menaces.

__NOTOC__ Night Mistresses are female undead located in the Guest Chambers in Karazhan. They are disguised as humans, but at 50% health they reveal their true appearance, removing all debuffs in the process. Night Lords are the male equivalent.
Nexus-Prince's Ring of Balance is an melee physical DPS ring.

Night of the Dragon is a novel by Richard A. Knaak, published on November 18, 2008 — five days after the release of World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King. It is a follow-up to the 2001 novel Day of the Dragon, and also provides insight into events leading up to Wrath of the Lich King. In addition, it follows up on several of the characters and storylines introduced in the Sunwell Trilogy and Shadow Wing mangas.

Nifflevar is a vrykul town belonging to the Dragonflayer clan, located high atop the cliffs surrounding Daggercap Bay in Howling Fjord. Sitting in the shadow of Utgarde Keep itself, it is much larger than Wyrmskull Village and high on the cliffs. Many of the wooden vrykul houses are built over the edge of the cliff, with naught but a walkway between a person and a long fall followed by a final splash. The village boasts a number of harpoon guns of different sizes, all of them trained on Daggercap Bay below. A large portion of Nifflevar's structures is built onto the cliff face. Night Elf Plans combine the Night Elf Plans: An'daroth, the Night Elf Plans: An'owyn, and the Night Elf Plans: Scrying on the Sin'dorei, which are all operations planned by the Sentinel spies.
Nexus Terrors are voidwraiths that can be found in Mana-Tombs, when doing the quest Someone Else's Hard Work Pays Off.
Night Elf Commoners show up only during Holiday events inside Darnassus. They usually show up in pairs.
The Night Elf Male Mask is a mask that can be used players at any level. It can either be purchased from a vendor for or occasionally contained in the Handful of Treats or the Loot-Filled Pumpkin.
__NOTOC__ Nightbane Dark Runners are worgen found in Duskwood.

The Night Elf Plans: An'daroth is located on Shalandis Isle in the Ghostlands.
__NOTOC__ Nightbane Vile Fangs are worgen found in Duskwood.
__NOTOC__ Nightbane Tainted Ones are worgen found in Duskwood.
__NOTOC__ Nightbane Shadow Weavers are worgen found in Duskwood.
Night Elf Ambushers are a couple of Sentinel spies that will attack after you complete the quest Deliver the Plans to An'telas, in an attempt to retrieve their plans back. They ride saber cats.

The Night Watch Guard is a human found in Duskwood, patrolling the Alliance town of Darkshire. Though the name may imply otherwise, there is only one Night Watch Guard patrolling Darkshire. However, level 90 versions of this guard will appear if PvP action is made by a Horde player.
Night of the Dead is a death knight talent located on tier 4 of the Unholy tree.

.]] A nian is a huge, two-headed, dog-like beast. They tend to be categorized as beasts and demons. Nian belong to the core hound group due to their large, flaming roar. The name "nian" is taken from the game files, as no other name is known.

This quest is a followup to Say Hello to My Little Friend only in that said quest directs you to this NPC who might otherwise be missed. This quest can be acquired without having completed Little Friend.
Nexus Residue is the buff that was given to tailors when they create a Spellweave.
The Night Elf Ancient of War can be found in the Hyjal Summit instance.
The Nidvar Stair is a stairway just pass the Njorn Stair in Utgarde Keep. Skarvald the Constructor and Dalronn the Controller can be found at the base of the stairway.
Nicole Morris is a Forsaken located in the docked ship at Vengeance Landing along with her family Julian, Jason, and Jessica Morris.

Night hag are creatures that serve that inhabite the Twisting Nether. They can mount on nightmares. Other types of hags are described in Manual of Monsters Appendix Three, however the validity of the source is disputed.
Night Elf Wisps are wisps floating around Hyjal Summit in Caverns of Time.

The Night Elf Mohawk was a night elf found near all starting areas on Azeroth. His companion, Mighty Frostsaber, was nearby. Talking to him would give players the option to receive five Mohawk Grenades. He returned for the 20th Anniversary event, and he can be found at the event grounds outside the Caverns of Time during the event.
Night Web Crossbow is a quest reward from Night Web's Hollow (quest).
Night Elf Slayer is a PvP guild achievement requiring an honorable kill on all Night Elf classes.
Nifflevar Bearded Axe is a rare archaeology artifact that requires 375 skill to find and 130 Vrykul Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to three Vrykul Rune Stick keystones may be used to complete it.

Nibb Spindlegear is a gnome quest giver who has come to Honor's Stand in the Southern Barrens to survey the recent seismic activity there. She is located between two tents in the northern part of the outpost by the vendors. She may be hidden by some grass for those whose environment detail is set too high.

__NOTOC__ Night-Stalker Ku'nanji is a jungle troll rogue trainer located in Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade. As a member of the Uncrowned, he is also found in the Hall of Shadows.
Night Watch Vest is a quest reward from Wolves at Our Heels.
Night Watch Boots are a quest reward from Wolves at Our Heels.
Night Elf Sentinels are part of the night elven forces sent from Darnassus to help in the final push against the Horde in Gilneas. They are stationed at Keel Harbor.

The Night Elf Grave is found east of Astranaar in Ashenvale. While on the quest Tragedy and Family, one learns both that Valstann Staghelm lies buried there and what his relation to Leyara and Fandral Staghelm was. It is discovered that Leyara and Valstann had a daughter, Istaria. After the Fourth War, Rexxar brought Zekhan to the grave. Its headstone, no longer readable, a smoke-stained locket had been placed carefully atop it. Rexxar said that the grave reminded him of all that the Horde has taken in its campaigns.
Niffelem Forefathers are found at Thunderfall in the Storm Peaks.
Niffelem Forst Giants are found near Dun Niffelem in The Storm Peaks.
Ni the Merciful is a pandaren innkeeper located at Crane Wing Refuge in the Krasarang Wilds.
Next of Kin concludes the Horde quest chain involving Gann Stonespire at Bael Modan. It also acts as a breadcrumb quest to direct players to Dustwallow Marsh.
__NOTOC__ Ni Gentlepaw is a pandaren alchemy trainer and supplier in the town of Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest.
Nicolette Garner is a Forsaken vendor located at Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.

Nicki Tinytech is a gnome master Pet Tamer located along the Path of Glory in Hellfire Peninsula. She is surrounded by her three mechanical battle pets: Goliath, Sploder, and ED-005. Defeating her is required to complete the Taming Outland achievement.
__NOTOC__ Nexus Whelplings are blue whelps located in Coldarra in the Borean Tundra.
__NOTOC__ Newt is a goblin and part of the Gob Squad. She is seen in Azshara and the Twilight Highlands. She is also present in the Secrets of Ragefire and in Nazmir.
Night Terrors are sha that spawn in large numbers by the Apparitions of Fear before engaging the Protectors of the Endless in the Terrace of Endless Spring.
Nibbleh is the second Rank 4 combatant in the Brawler's Guild.
__NOTOC__ Nibi Nibi is a hozen quest giver found in Camp Nooka Nooka in the Jade Forest.

Nice Sprites are found in a large group at the Everlasting Spritewood tree northeast of Old Pi'jiu on Timeless Isle. Normally friendly to players, they will turn into hostile Angry Sprites to players who use the Neverending Spritewood that spawns 75 yards to the east. Players who use the spritewood will also spawn Scary Sprites nearby. While hostile, the sprites may drop the Dandelion Frolicker combat pet.

Nick Carpenter is the former Vice President of Art & Cinematic Development for Blizzard Entertainment. After leaving Blizzard in September 2016, Carpenter was announced as cofounder of the new [http://www.bonfirestudios.com/ Bonfire Studios], alongside other ex-Blizzard personnel including former Chief Creative Officer Rob Pardo. Carpenter brought his love to the art, characters, and worlds of Warcraft III, StarCraft: Brood War, World of Warcraft, StarCraft II, and Diablo III. As VP of Art and Cinematics, he moved his craft to the big screen as one of the co-producers for the 2016 Warcraft film.
Nicki Quipper is a gnome found aboard the boat The Measure north of Temple of Karabor in .

:"The ethereals have their own jousting tournament, and Saraad is the reigning champion. Also he won the ethereal hot dog eating contest." :— Flavor text Nexus-Champion Saraad is an ethereal taking part in the Grand Tournament. His mount is an energy-camel and he wields an energy-lance.
Nidrorian is an employee of Blizzard Entertainment. He or she is a Community Manager for World of Warcraft forums for the European region.

Nicholas Mitrik is a Forsaken quest giver and vendor that can show up at the Town Hall of the Horde Tier 3 garrison in Frostwall. He trades Primal Spirits for Draenor herbs and specialty patterns intended for inscribers and alchemists.

Nicholaus Page is a Forsaken quest giver imprisoned in a Reinforced Iron Cage at Grom'gar in Frostfire Ridge. He has been working to crack Draenic texts, before being caught and imprisoned. After getting help from the Horde Commander, he said that he would take a look at the documents before sneaking out of Grom'gar.
Nick Jameson is a voice actor who has provided voices for World of Warcraft.
Nick Omana is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Night Devint: The Perfection of Arcwine is a quest reward from Vengeance for Margaux.

Nightborne: Twilight of Suramar is a comic published digitally by Blizzard Entertainment as the second of several tie-ins for the World of Warcraft: Legion expansion. It details the decision made by Grand Magistrix Elisande and the nightborne to ally with the Burning Legion.
The Night Dreamer Robe drops from Dresaron in Darkheart Thicket.
Nez'val is a doomguard that appears at Legion Invasion locations and in Val'sharah during Legion Assaults.

The Night Market is a market found on a small peninsula in the southern central Revendreth. The place is run by Ta'xera and her fellow brokers of Cartel Ta. Market Collectors can be seen gathering pieces of the local flora, presumably shipping them off-world. Cartel Ta was given permission to establish the Night Market by the The Fearstalker. It is where the Black Market Auction House is located in the Shadowlands.

Nightmare Vale is a wide valley located just west of the Scarlet Watchtower in southwestern Tirisfal Glades. While the glades here were once verdant and teeming with forest animals, now the trees have withered and the wildlife has been eaten by hungry darkhounds and huge vampire bats. Ressan the Needler, a rare white bat, also appears here.
Nightmare Engulfed Object is a drop from the Dragons of Nightmare guarding the Gates to the Emerald Dream.

Nightsong Woods is the eastern part of Ashenvale forest, stretching from Raynewood Retreat and the road to Felwood in the west, all the way east to Azshara. This is where most of the heavy cross-faction fighting occurs, and where the Warsong Clan and the Silverwing Sentinels have their holdings. The Falfarren River runs through the Nightsong Woods, roughly dividing it into a western Alliance-aligned part, and an eastern Horde-aligned part. A second, nameless river farther to the east separates Splintertree Post, which is the center of operations for Horde in the region, and Alliance-controlled Silverwing Grove from the easternmost part, which is probably the most contested part of Ashenvale:
